in_marathi.name: Hiranpriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loved by Deer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hiranpriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hiranpriya means 'loved by deer'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'hiran' meaning 'deer' and 'priya' meaning 'loved'. In Hindu mythology, Hiranpriya could refer to the name of the goddess Lakshmi, who is often depicted with a deer as her mount.
